comment: RFC 3339 Appendix A defines the ABNF grammar for ISO-8601 durations used by JSON Schema format 'duration'. These tests enforce only the syntax defined by that grammar.

tests.description: an invalid duration string
must start with P
no elements present
no time elements present
no date or time elements present
elements out of order
missing time separator
time element in the date position
weeks cannot be combined with other units
invalid non-ASCII '২' (a Bengali 2)
element without unit
fractional duration is not allowed by RFC 3339 ABNF
tests.comment: numeric components use 1*DIGIT where DIGIT = %x30-39; '.' is not allowed

tests.description: leading whitespace is invalid
trailing whitespace is invalid
empty string is invalid
years and days cannot appear without months
hours and seconds cannot appear without minutes
a leading sign is not allowed
a number before the time separator has no unit
exponent notation is not allowed in a component
a trailing newline is invalid
weeks cannot be combined with a time component
weeks cannot be combined with a zero-valued component
a comma as the decimal separator is invalid
a sign inside a component is invalid
